events.quote: The impugned order was preceded by a show cause notice under Section 73 of the Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act/Central Government Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 in DRC 01 dated 25.11.2024.
The petitioner did not respond to the same and thus, suffered the impugned assessment order.
It is noticed that the petitioner has not appeared for personal hearing despite two reminders have been sent.
The petitioner has approached this Court against the impugned order, dated 24.02.2025 for the assessment year 2020-2021 passed by the respondent.

outcome.quote: Therefore, the impugned order stands quashed and the case is remitted back to the respondent to pass fresh orders on merits and in accordance with law.
